title: MangoEC
body:
🍃 Ultra Lightweight
Clean, optimized code with zero unnecessary dependencies.

📦 Plug & Play
Drop the plugin in your server and start using it instantly.

🛠️ Anti-Dupe Protection
Safe inventory handling designed to prevent common Ender Chest duplication exploits.

🔒 Administrative Access
Admins can inspect and manage any online player’s Ender Chest with simple permissions.



Command 	Aliases 	Function 	Permission

/enderchest /echest, /ec Opens your Ender Chest mangoec.use

/enderchest <name> ec <name> Opens others' chest mangoec.admin
